headline: Apple Watch Siri AI still missing in watchOS 11 beta
summary: The highly anticipated AI-powered Siri for Apple Watch has been delayed for the second year in a row, missing the watchOS 11 beta release.
details: Apple's integration of advanced AI into Siri for the Apple Watch was expected to be a major feature in the latest software updates.
However, the AI-powered Siri has failed to appear in the watchOS 11 beta, which was released this summer, sparking disappointment among users and analysts.
This marks the second consecutive year that the feature has been delayed, raising questions about Apple's development priorities and execution for its wearable AI capabilities.
While the exact reasons for the delay remain unclear, it suggests that Apple is facing significant challenges in optimizing AI for the power-constrained environment of the Apple Watch.
The absence of AI Siri on the Apple Watch leaves a notable gap in the device's smart capabilities, especially as competitors continue to advance their own AI integrations.
Users were hoping for a more conversational and context-aware Siri that could handle complex queries and tasks directly on their wrist without relying heavily on the iPhone.
caption:
Apple's AI-powered Siri has been delayed again, missing the watchOS 11 beta release for the second year running.

Apple's integration of advanced AI into Siri for the Apple Watch was expected to be a major feature in the latest software updates.

However, the AI-powered Siri has failed to appear in the watchOS 11 beta, which was released this summer, sparking disappointment among users and analysts.

This marks the second consecutive year that the feature has been delayed, raising questions about Apple's development priorities and execution for its wearable AI capabilities.

While the exact reasons for the delay remain unclear, it suggests that Apple is facing significant challenges in optimizing AI for the power-constrained environment of the Apple Watch.

The absence of AI Siri on the Apple Watch leaves a notable gap in the device's smart capabilities, especially as competitors continue to advance their own AI integrations.

Users were hoping for a more conversational and context-aware Siri that could handle complex queries and tasks directly on their wrist without relying heavily on the iPhone.

headline: SwitchBot launches AI MindClip wearable for $119.99
summary: This lightweight clip-on AI assistant records up to 20 hours of conversations, organizing them into notes and summaries.
details: SwitchBot, known for its smart home devices, is entering the AI wearable market with the new AI MindClip. This device aims to capture daily conversations and transform them into organized personal notes.

The AI MindClip weighs just 68 grams and boasts an impressive 20-hour recording capacity with 64GB of internal storage. It also features speaker separation to distinguish different speakers and segment conversations.

Users can manage and search captured content through the SwitchBot app or website. The AI MindClip organizes moments into categories like Timeline, Priority, Daily Memory, Weekly Summary, and To-Do Overview.

For enhanced productivity, the device syncs with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Reminders. SwitchBot emphasizes privacy with encrypted pairing, file transfer, end-to-end encryption, and in-app data management settings.
Priced at $119.99, the AI MindClip requires a subscription for usage exceeding 300 minutes per month. A six-month free trial of the Pro plan (1,200 minutes) is included.
